SMTO-CFG-0017 — The conversation link or reference isn't valid

GUID: 04413d8e-0eaa-4390-818a-0f703727b567
Slug: composer-identity-invalid
Domain: CFG · Subsystem: cfg

What happened

  • SMTO was asked to load or change a conversation's settings, but the conversation reference has characters or a length SMTO never uses, for example from a link that was cut off or edited. Nothing was changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open the Conversations pane and select the conversation from the list, or find it with Search conversations…. The list always uses the conversation's real reference, so it opens correctly.
  2. If you used a shared or bookmarked link, copy the full link again from where it came from, without missing or extra characters at the end. A link that was cut short or changed points to a conversation reference SMTO can't use.
  3. If the conversation isn't in the list, select New chat to continue. A new conversation gets a valid reference straight away.

What success looks like

  • The conversation opens from the list, and its settings above the message box load without an error.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send it, with the link you used, to the person who manages SMTO. Don't keep reopening the same link; it will fail the same way.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The composer namespace check rejected the conversation ID because it is not a 1–160 character string of word characters and hyphens.

What this means

  • The conversation namespace identifier is not a string matching 1–160 word or hyphen characters. Validation reports the owning configuration boundary; it does not change settings, migrate retained state or grant authority. Existing tasks retain their accepted snapshots unless the specific control explicitly supports a live change.

Why this can happen

  • The conversation namespace identifier is not a string matching 1–160 word or hyphen characters.

How to diagnose it

  • Check the exact returned conversation ID and its length rather than inventing a replacement identity.

How to fix it

  • Use the server-issued conversation_id (it must match ^[\w-]{1,160}$, normally conv_ followed by a generated ID) in composer-profile requests and /agent-ui?conversation= links. Refresh the conversation list instead of building or truncating IDs by hand.
  • Refresh the conversation list and select its current identity.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • A valid existing conversation ID resolves its composer namespace.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Validation reports the owning configuration boundary; it does not change settings, migrate retained state or grant authority. Existing tasks retain their accepted snapshots unless the specific control explicitly supports a live change.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
